body: Next SOURCE-ONLY bounded route approved: A maina1d51f6b now provides Compositor::render_region(doc,level,Rect,cancel), returning full straight-alpha tiles intersecting clipped level-pixel region in raster order, one shared FilterPass, level>=24 rejected. 19tests/strict pass, evidence RES-04. Implement Document viewport CPU-frame cancellation in separate render.rs commit against this API: Signal owns active per-frame token; real frame request/stop cancels current token, layers-only notification does not; install/cleanup identity-safe under Signal lock, release locks before work. cpu_present uses render_region over existing src, not whole-image fallback; cancellation checks during surface copy and before frame publication, generation checks retained. Unpublished partial surface must never be presented as complete; ensure it is safely overwritten/recycled. Token cancel must not wait on backend lock blocked by rendering. GPU path may check boundaries only; do not claim GPU preemption. Keep public synchronous readback, PSD-copy operation handles, destructive apply and engine-api outside this slice; no new fresh-token calls advertised as host cancellation. Add tiny deterministic Signal ownership/supersession/close and cancelled CPU region/no-presentation tests UNRUN B; no largefixtures or workloads. A preview/bake d9974d7 validation queued onA; viewport b2f8d85 accepted for A gates; avoid A-owned outline seam/test. No B builds/tests/apps/benchmarks or heartbeat restart. A sole main merges; report exact source commit and limits.
